title: From Concept Erasure to Style Purification: Contrastive Eigenbases for Artist Style Protection
abstract: arXiv:2602.08059v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can reproduce specific artists visual styles at extremely low cost, raising copyright and deployment safety concerns about unauthorized style mimicry. Existing model-side protection methods generally follow ordinary concept erasure, emphasizing aggressive deletion or redirection of target styles. However, our causal intervention analysis shows that the central issue is not insufficient erasure strength, but a mismatch between artist styles and this paradigm: unlike ordinary object concepts, artist styles do not form compact, localized editable semantic units. Consequently, sparse editing and fixed retain lists struggle to suppress target styles while preserving generation utility. We therefore reformulate artist style protection as style purification, suppressing target style expression during inference while preserving the requested content and visual structure. translated_title: 从概念擦除到风格净化：用于艺术家风格保护的对比特征基方法
translated_abstract: 文生图扩散模型能够以极低的成本再现特定艺术家的视觉风格，这引发了关于未经授权风格模仿的版权与部署安全方面的担忧。现有的模型端保护方法通常遵循普通的概念擦除范式，强调对目标风格进行激进的删除或重定向。然而，我们的因果干预分析表明，核心问题并非擦除强度不足，而是艺术家风格与该范式之间的不匹配：与普通物体概念不同，艺术家风格并不形成紧凑的、局部化的、可编辑的语义单元。因此，稀疏编辑和固定的保留列表难以在抑制目标风格的同时保持生成实用性。为此，我们将艺术家风格保护重新表述为风格净化，即在推理过程中抑制目标风格的表达，同时保留所请求的内容和视觉结构。我们提出了 CAPE（对比艺术...
tldr: 本文通过因果干预分析揭示艺术家风格与现有概念擦除范式不匹配的根本原因，将艺术家风格保护重新表述为“风格净化”问题，并提出基于对比特征基的 CAPE 方法，在推理时抑制目标风格表达的同时保留内容与视觉结构的生成能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through causal intervention analysis that artist styles, unlike ordinary object concepts, do not form compact editable semantic units, and reformulates artist style protection as style purification, proposing CAPE with contrastive eigenbases to suppress target style expression during inference while preserving requested content and visual structure.
